definition: Business process automation (BPA), also known as business automation, refers to the technology-enabled automation of business processes..
details: Business process automation (BPA), also known as business automation, refers to the technology-enabled automation of business processes.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Business process automation — a small key that opens a big door.
